task.title: Inspect one persisted recurrence occurrence through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/881 by exposing exact read-only persisted occurrence lookup without scanning unrelated streams.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence identity before opening storage and address one exact recurrence-and-offset coordinate.
Emit compact deterministic occurrence provenance JSON for a found immutable record.
Distinguish invalid identity, absent storage or coordinate, selected corruption, and infrastructure failure while ignoring unrelated corruption and preserving read-only authority.

attempts.summary: Established RED exact persisted-occurrence CLI coverage.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused CLI integration tests failed because recurrence occurrence was not a recognized subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added success, invalid identity, missing database, absent coordinate, selected corruption, unrelated corruption isolation, output, and non-mutation tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Inventory-based discovery would inspect unrelated streams and allow unrelated corruption to block a caller-selected coordinate.
attempts.patch: Added recurrence occurrence, validated identity before read-only open, delegated exact replay to RecurrenceStore::load_occurrence, reused occurrence JSON, categorized diagnostics, and documented ADR-0047.

attempts.diagnostic: The initial CodeRabbit status was rate limited and therefore could not authorize auto-merge.
attempts.patch: Left auto-merge unarmed, resumed after cooldown, and merged after exact-head no-actionable-comments review, successful Rust quality gate, and zero unresolved threads.

outcome.summary: The CLI retrieves one exact immutable persisted recurrence occurrence in read-only mode with deterministic output and corruption isolation.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0173-exact-persisted-recurrence-occurrence-cli.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 174 records: 174 valid, 0 invalid

lessons: Exact coordinate lookup should address its owning stream instead of filtering an inventory.
Read-only opening and pre-open identity validation make non-mutation part of the enforced boundary.
Selected malformed provenance must fail closed while unrelated malformed streams remain outside the lookup domain.
Distinct absent-coordinate and corruption diagnostics preserve actionable failure taxonomy.
Rate-limited false-green review states must not race auto-merge.
